artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: 27 questions quoted from repo records of a staff member asking them. Each has id, question, asker, source (path:line) and expected_tool. 27 of 27 quotes were found at the cited line (worker's check, window of the line plus 2). The 8 asks in the Analyst's thread memory are Q01-Q06, Q26 and Q27. The other 19 come from logs, orders, a change record and call transcripts. Expected tools: 3 datasets (Q05 and Q07 json/benchmarks/model_portfolio_benchmarks.json, Q22 json-tiered/market-overview/summary/all-returns.json) and 24 NOT_CATALOGUED. Nothing is deployed.

Offline harness. It calls opal_discover.discover(question, OPAL_INTERNAL, '') on the catalog loaded through query_v0._catalog(). The routed tool is the answer's first match: the portal_index tool whose accessor names that row, otherwise query_v0:<dataset key>. With no match it is NOT_CATALOGUED. The harness prints one line per question and ends with 'ROUTING: k of n routed to the expected tool'. --plant-mislabel swaps the expected tool of the first hit. It reads no S3 and writes nothing; audit.jsonl was unchanged after every run (git status clean).
Rows NFRA_MCPINDEX-Z-W2-S7, -S8 and -S9 were appended (surprise-row-gate: 3 new rows of 34, OK; the diff is 69 insertions and 0 deletions). No existing row was edited.

mutant.description: --plant-mislabel swaps the expected tool of the first question the plain run scores as a hit (Q01: NOT_CATALOGUED -> query_v0:json/benchmarks/model_portfolio_benchmarks.json). A second, unplanned negative arm also fired: the draft set cited Q05 at 2026-08-20.md:14, and the worker's quote-at-line check showed the ST ask sits at :13, so the citation was corrected before the commit.
mutant.expected: The score falls by exactly 1 over the same n.
mutant.observed: The plain run reported 'ROUTING: 21 of 27'. The planted run printed 'CONTROL: planted mislabel on Q01 ...', showed Q01 as a MISS, and reported 'ROUTING: 20 of 27'. Both exited rc=0.

determinism.method: The same inputs were run several times: the harness directly (25-question draft and 27-question set), the AC2 check before the commit and the AC2 check after it.
determinism.observed: On the 27-question set every run gave 21 of 27 with the same 6 misses (Q05, Q07, Q09, Q13, Q22, Q25), and every planted run gave 20 of 27. Routing is a pure function of the committed catalog and question file.
